title: State Library of Queensland

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified government DEM at the Stanley Place approach, west of the mapped main entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap State Library of Queensland and The Edge outlines
mapIdentity.scope: The separately named State Library and The Edge building outlines and three currently mapped entrance and Knowledge Walk paths preserve the current site and public passage. The two buildings remain separate.

note: The library’s tour and level guide describe five library levels, the covered open-air Knowledge Walk and floating balcony, shaded river decks, an external red reading room with two levels of glazing, and Stanley Place exterior blades. The state conservation plan and design team describe recessed river glazing, cubic concrete masses, terraces and overhangs.
